name: Gradient of 2D Gaussian PDF (Conic)
aliases: Gradient of 2D Gaussian Probability Density (Normalized/Unnormalized Factor Only)
Gradient of 2D Gaussian Probability Density from Conic and Rescale
definition: Computes the probability density $p$ and its gradients with respect to mean ($d_p/d\_mean$) and covariance ($d_p/d\_cov$) using the conic representation. The gradient w.r.t. the rescale factor is not computed.
summary: Computes 2D Gaussian probability density and its gradients for optimization, using a conic matrix representation to bypass explicit covariance inversion.
